title: 固定顶点预算下基于回填误差的二值外轮廓多边形编码
scope: One known binary exterior, ordinary offline annotation export, exact integer coordinates decoded by OpenCV LINE_8 at native size; no recognition or segmentation claim.
source_unit: Original photo. Paired mean over K=16 and 32. Equal weights per photo.
bootstrap: 10000 paired photo bootstrap resamples, percentile 95%, seed 37129. Secondary breed-cluster bootstrap. Require primary lower bound > 0 and positive mean IoU at both budgets, and versus every alternative comparator.
incomplete: Any missing/corrupt/failing photo, wrong byte count, non-simple polygon or failed listed gate invalidates advancement. Retain all outcomes, no threshold change. Next confirmation for a modified method must use fresh unseen content.
case_rule: For the frozen primary comparator choose source with maximum, nearest-median and minimum mean relative XOR gain across budgets, and source with largest remaining normalized XOR at 16 vertices. Show K=16 for each. Log actual local error and any per-budget losses.
